description: Defines the TConstantUnion class, representing a union of constant values with methods for setting, comparing, and performing operations on constants, used in shader translation.
external_methods: bool operator==(const unsigned int u) const
bool operator!=(const unsigned int u) const
static TConstantUnion add(const TConstantUnion &lhs, const TConstantUnion &rhs, TDiagnostics *diag, const TSourceLoc &line)
static TConstantUnion sub(const TConstantUnion &lhs, const TConstantUnion &rhs, TDiagnostics *diag, const TSourceLoc &line)
static TConstantUnion mul(const TConstantUnion &lhs, const TConstantUnion &rhs, TDiagnostics *diag, const TSourceLoc &line)
static TConstantUnion rshift(const TConstantUnion &lhs, const TConstantUnion &rhs, TDiagnostics *diag, const TSourceLoc &line)
static TConstantUnion lshift(const TConstantUnion &lhs, const TConstantUnion &rhs, TDiagnostics *diag, const TSourceLoc &line)

classes.name: TConstantUnion
classes.description: Represents a union of constant values (int, uint, float, bool, or YUV CSC standard) used in shader translation, with methods for setting, comparison, and arithmetic operations.

methods.name: setIConst
methods.description: Sets the constant as an integer value and updates the type.

methods.name: setUConst
methods.description: Sets the constant as an unsigned integer value and updates the type.

methods.name: setFConst
methods.description: Sets the constant as a float value and updates the type.

methods.name: setBConst
methods.description: Sets the constant as a boolean value and updates the type.

methods.name: setYuvCscStandardEXTConst
methods.description: Sets the constant as a YUV CSC standard extension value and updates the type.

methods.name: getUConst
methods.description: Returns the unsigned integer constant value.

methods.name: isZero
methods.description: Checks if the constant value is zero.

methods.name: getYuvCscStandardEXTConst
methods.description: Returns the YUV CSC standard extension constant.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the constant.
